part of 'int64_consumer_test.dart';

void verifyJSONProjection() {
  test('nested inputs preserve Binary row bytes and JSON fields', () {
    const input = CreateInput(child: ChildInput(name: 'nested'));
    final encoder = sdk.LuxoEncoder();
    input.writeLuxo(encoder);
    expect(encoder.bytes(), [0, 1, 6, 1, 6, 110, 101, 115, 116, 101, 100, 0, 0]);
    expect(input.toJson(), {'child': {'name': 'nested'}});
  });
  test('selected Bytes and nested objects retain their JSON projection', () {
    final row = <String, Object?>{
      'data': 'AAH/',
      'child': {'name': 'nested'},
    };
    final value = Payload.fromJson(row);
    expect(value.data.value, [0, 1, 255]);
    expect(value.child.value.name.value, 'nested');
    expect(value.toJson(), row);
    expect(sdk.decodeLuxoJSON(sdk.encodeLuxoJSON(value)), row);
    expect(value.metadata.isSelected, isFalse);
    expect(value.chunks.isSelected, isFalse);
  });
  test('generated HTTP responses keep JSON128 independent from model64', () async {
    var body = '';
    final transport = sdk.HttpTransport(
      'http://example.test/luxo',
      client: MockClient((_) async => http.Response(body, 200)),
    );
    final client = LuxoClient(transport);
    addTearDown(client.close);
    final json128 = '${'[' * 128}null${']' * 128}';
    body = '{"data":{"metadata":$json128}}';
    expect((await client.createSnapshot()).metadata.value, isA<List>());
    body = '{"data":[{"metadata":$json128}]}';
    expect((await client.listPayloads()).single.metadata.value, isA<List>());
    body =
        '{"data":{"items":[{"metadata":$json128}],"total":1,"page":1,"pageSize":10}}';
    expect(
      (await client.listPayloadPage()).items.single.metadata.value,
      isA<List>(),
    );
    body = '{"data":$json128}';
    expect(await client.scalarJSON(), isA<List>());
    for (final depth in [64, 65]) {
      body =
          '{"data":${'{"child":' * (depth - 1)}{"child":null}${'}' * (depth - 1)}}';
      if (depth == 64) {
        await client.projection();
      } else {
        await expectLater(
          client.projection(),
          throwsA(
            isA<sdk.LuxoError>().having(
              (error) => error.error,
              'error',
              'ParseError',
            ),
          ),
        );
      }
    }
  });
  test(
    'JSON model lists reject every fieldless record before delivery',
    _rejectFieldlessRows,
  );
  test(
    'nested model and type lists enforce projection recursively',
    _rejectNestedRows,
  );
  test(
    'valid selections, singleton objects and generic JSON keep their meaning',
    _validProjections,
  );
  test(
    'valid nested selections and unary constructors remain compatible',
    _validNestedProjections,
  );
}

Future<void> _rejectFieldlessRows() async {
  final transport = _ResponseTransport(),
      valid = {'metadata': <String, Object?>{}};
  final client = LuxoClient(transport);
  var delivered = 0;
  final cancel = await client.subscribeWatchPayloadList(
    onData: (_) => delivered++,
  );
  for (final bad in [
    {},
    {'unknown': true},
  ]) {
    for (final rows in [
      [bad],
      [valid, bad],
      [bad, valid],
      [valid, bad, valid],
    ]) {
      transport.response = _projectionWire(rows);
      await expectLater(
        client.listPayloads(select: 'metadata'),
        throwsFormatException,
      );
      expect(
        () => transport.emit(_projectionWire(rows) as Object),
        throwsFormatException,
      );
      expect(delivered, 0);
      transport.response = _projectionWire({
        'items': rows,
        'total': rows.length,
        'page': 1,
        'pageSize': 3,
      });
      await expectLater(
        client.listPayloadPage(select: 'metadata'),
        throwsFormatException,
      );
    }
  }
  for (final rows in [
    [null],
    [true],
    ['text'],
    [[]],
    [7],
  ]) {
    transport.response = rows;
    await expectLater(
      client.listPayloads(select: 'metadata'),
      throwsA(isA<TypeError>()),
    );
  }
  cancel();
}

void _rejectNestedRows() {
  for (final field in ['models', 'children']) {
    for (final bad in [
      {},
      {'unknown': true},
    ]) {
      final data = <String, dynamic>{
        field: [bad],
      };
      for (final row in [
        data,
        {'child': data},
        {
          'children': [data],
        },
      ]) {
        expect(
          () =>
              Projection.fromJson(_projectionWire(row) as Map<String, dynamic>),
          throwsFormatException,
        );
      }
    }
  }
}

Future<void> _validProjections() async {
  final transport = _ResponseTransport();
  final listClient = LuxoClient(transport);
  List<Payload>? received;
  final cancel = await listClient.subscribeWatchPayloadList(
    onData: (value) => received = value,
  );
  for (final rows in [
    [],
    [
      {'metadata': {}},
    ],
    [
      {'chunks': []},
    ],
    [
      {'child': {}},
    ],
  ]) {
    transport.response = _projectionWire(rows);
    expect((await listClient.listPayloads()).map((e) => e.toJson()), rows);
    received = null;
    transport.emit(transport.response!);
    expect(received?.map((e) => e.toJson()), rows);
    transport.response = _projectionWire({
      'items': rows,
      'total': rows.length,
      'page': 1,
      'pageSize': 3,
    });
    expect(
      (await listClient.listPayloadPage()).items.map((e) => e.toJson()),
      rows,
    );
  }
  transport.response = [
    {},
    null,
    {'unknown': []},
  ];
  expect(await listClient.arrayJSON(), transport.response);
  cancel();
  listClient.close();
}

void _validNestedProjections() {
  for (final row in <Map<String, dynamic>>[
    {'children': []},
    {
      'children': [
        {'label': null},
      ],
    },
    {'child': {}},
    {
      'children': [
        {'child': {}},
        {'models': []},
      ],
    },
    {
      'models': [
        {'metadata': {}},
      ],
    },
  ]) {
    expect(
      Projection.fromJson(_projectionWire(row) as Map<String, dynamic>)
          .toJson(),
      row,
    );
  }
  expect(Payload.fromJson({}).toJson(), isEmpty);
  expect(
    [
      <String, dynamic>{},
      {'metadata': {}},
    ].map(Payload.fromJson).map((value) => value.toJson()).toList(),
    [
      {},
      {'metadata': {}},
    ],
  );
}

Object? _projectionWire(Object? value) =>
    sdk.decodeLuxoJSON(sdk.encodeLuxoJSON(value));
